Description: Claude writing help in the Umbraco backoffice. Polish text, translate pages, write SEO titles and descriptions, and add alt text to images, one item at a time or as a bulk job with a cost estimate. Brand voice rules keep the tone yours. A monthly spend cap is available. Free and MIT licensed.
